snippet.title: Everything Is Crab | Playtest 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
Come and get a *pincer* the action! Everything is Crab returns from the primordial ooze to give you another chance to try out the game ahead of its 2026 release!

Public Playtest 2 features over 90 evolutions, eight difficulty levels, and a handful of new challenge runs to tackle, from surviving the Ice Age to throwing in way too many boss creatures.

The Animal Evolution roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge & Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from over 100 mutations to evolve your creature in countless ways with every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying! 

Everything is Crab launches on PC via Steam in 2026, and the free playtest is available NOW!

Sign up for the playtest: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3526710/Everything_is_Crab_The_Animal_Evolution_Roguelite/

Follow Secret Mode: https://linktr.ee/wearesecretmode
Support us directly: https://store.wearesecretmode.com/
